inputs.name: ProjectSessionService.constructor.options
inputs.type: { registry?: ProjectRegistryService; outbox?: CommentOutboxService; cache?: ProjectionCacheService; remote?: RemoteProjectPort; auth?: NativeAuthService; arbiter?: RepositoryArbiterService; }
inputs.description: Registry, outbox and arbiter default to local services; cache, remote and auth may be absent.

inputs.name: ProjectSessionService.assertProject.projectId
inputs.description: Optional selected-project identity; a defined value must equal the current project ID.

inputs.name: ProjectSessionService.open.directory
inputs.description: A directory inside the repository to select.

inputs.name: ProjectSessionService.snapshot.query
inputs.description: Requested branch and commit with optional project identity.

outputs.name: ProjectSessionService.assertProject
outputs.description: Rejects a defined ID that differs from the currently selected project; undefined does nothing.

outputs.name: ProjectSessionService.selecting
outputs.description: True while an open operation is in progress.

outputs.name: ProjectSessionService.open
outputs.description: Refuses to switch while busy, pending or already opening; otherwise resolves the repository root, selects its project services and returns a snapshot.

outputs.name: ProjectSessionService.snapshot
outputs.description: Reads the requested revision and updates the session view; concurrent snapshot reads can update the view while another operation is pending.

outputs.name: ProjectSessionService.requireProject
outputs.description: Returns selected project services, without a project ID field; rejects when no project is open.

outputs.name: ProjectSessionService.mutable
outputs.description: Returns a promise for selected project services and a revision only when the current view is the checked-out branch tip and is not the evidence branch.

outputs.name: ProjectSessionService.atBranch
outputs.description: Returns selected project services if the checked-out branch matches the supplied name; otherwise rejects.

outputs.name: ProjectSessionService.projectId
outputs.description: Public selected project identity, assigned from registry.register(root).id during open.

outputs.name: ProjectSessionService.pending
outputs.description: Count of pending bridge operations. Opening another project is refused while this count is nonzero; callers own its lifetime.

errors.name: Project unavailable or mismatched
errors.description: A missing selected project or defined foreign project ID is rejected.

errors.name: Project switch blocked
errors.description: Opening is refused while a run, bridge operation or another open is in progress.

errors.name: Read-only revision or changed branch
errors.description: mutable rejects historical, non-current, non-tip and evidence-branch views; atBranch rejects a changed checked-out branch.

errors.name: Underlying project failure
errors.description: Filesystem, Git, registry, planning and catalog failures propagate.
